final: WITH country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM country_avg), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ca.avg_wins - oa.avg_wins AS excess FROM country_avg ca CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ca.avg_wins > oa.avg_wins), latter_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall), retained AS (SELECT ao.avg_wins, ao.excess, ao.avg_wins - la.avg_wins AS excess_latter FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN latter_avg la WHERE ao.avg_wins > la.avg_wins) SELECT AVG(avg_wins), AVG(excess), AVG(excess_latter) FROM retained
